name: NASA C-MAPSS Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Dataset
description: Simulated turbofan engine run-to-failure data generated with the Commercial Modular Aero-Propulsion System Simulation (C-MAPSS), comprising four subsets under different operating conditions and fault modes.
citation: A. Saxena and K. Goebel (2008). “Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set”, NASA Prognostics Data Repository, NASA Ames Research Center, Moffett Field, CA.
